datasets.name: ResultsDatSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT numberofcredit, 
       custname, 
       sum(drest) as drest , 
       sum(dinterestrest) as dinterestrest, 
       sum(dduerest) as dduerest,
       sum(ddueinterestrest) as ddueinterestrest
  FROM cm_controls
group by NUMBEROFCREDIT, custname

datasets.name: Branchs
datasets.sql:
select  -1 id ,'Bütün filiallar' name from filial
union
select  id ,name from filial

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
select id from smart.provarch p
where p.dat between :bdat and :edat
and vid_op=86 and id not in (select trid from cm_dovriye where 
trid is not null
) and name not like '%Kredit uzre ehtiyyatin deyishdirilmesi%'
union
select trid id from cm_dovriye where 
trid is not null and trid not in(select id from provarch where
 name not like '%Kredit uzre ehtiyyatin deyishdirilmesi%' and dat between :bdat and :edat)
 and dat between :bdat and :edat
 UNION
 select p.id from smart.provarch p ,cm_dovriye  t
where p.id=t.trid 
and
p.dat between :bdat and :edat
and 
p.ammount-t.ammount<>0 and p.name not like '%Kredit uzre ehtiyyatin deyishdirilmesi%'
and id not in (select tridprimreserve from cm_payments where paydate between :bdat and :edat and tridprimreserve is not null)
and id not in(select reservetrid  from cm_tranches where tranchedate between :bdat and :edat and reservetrid is not null)

datasets.name: OracleDataSet2
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.numberofcredit,p.dateofconclusion, s.rest,s.interestrest,h.interest from cm_active_credits p,cm_int_currstate h,
cm_curr_state s
where p.id=h.creditid and p.id=s.creditid and 
p.dateofconclusion<sbop.get_date and 
trprocessed<>2 and s.rest>0 and s.stopcalcdate is null
